snippet.title: Bug Heroes Quest -- Trailer
snippet.description:
Now available! Get it now on the app store! http://bit.ly/oqfSwK

Enter Bug Heroes Quest, a spin off of the critically acclaimed game by Foursaken Media, Bug Heroes! Embark on an epic, story based adventure through a variety of huge environments. Explore, level up, equip, fight, talk, and more! Experience a new blend of action, adventure, and RPG on your Apple iOS device!

Don't know what Bug Heroes is all about? Download the game that started it all, FREE!
http://itunes.apple.com/us/app/bug-heroes/id412789616?mt=8

Available NOW for the iPhone, iPod Touch, and iPad. For more information follow Foursaken Media on Facebook and Twitter!
